propositions: Bare-repository fixture commands using implicit cwd-based discovery fail with exit 128 under safe.bareRepository=explicit (git config gc.autoDetach false and git symbolic-ref HEAD both affected)
Generic helpers designed for worktrees mask repository kind and prevent explicit repository targeting needed for safe.bareRepository=explicit compatibility
Production restore operation in prepare_reclaim_backup.py::_verify_restore uses shared cwd-based helper on owned throwaway bare repository and fails under strict policy
Explicit top-level --git-dir targeting on identical bare repositories succeeds under safe.bareRepository=explicit while preserving worktree semantics for non-bare calls
Supported test suite must run identically under both default Git configuration and isolated safe.bareRepository=explicit without mutating host/global Git settings
